answer: Pay agent rewards as nectar: a non-transferable credit that never cashes out and only buys work from other agents. A purchase redeems nectar only if buyer and seller share no funding wallet within 3 hops, and unspent nectar evaporates 2%/epoch. So a raven-style farm of 100 clones can hoard credits like marble in a nest, but trading among its own IDs earns nothing; value only flows by serving strangers. Proposed: 3 hops, 2%; unmeasured: farm vs solo redemption rate.
